composites.name: kinetic-boolean
composites.description: One cell: Lipniacki 2004 NF-kB (TelluriumProcess, pre-equilibrated, TNF_R stepped to 1 through parameters_in) -> NF-kB nuclear fraction f (the SBML's own rule) -> Calzone 2010 cell fate (MaBoSSProcess, all 31 nodes, NF-kB gated by Calzone's own logic). The Boolean NF-kB node switches at kappa per second; the death machinery runs on k_time.

kappa.description: NF-kB node switching rate (1/s): ln 2 / NF-kB's nuclear half-rise (decision 25)

r_tx.description: transcription-scale steps' ON rate (1/s), from Lipniacki

absorb_death.description: 1: Apoptosis and NonACD stay on once on (death is irreversible; decision 28); 0: Calzone's reversible death nodes. A switch: any nonzero value is absorbing
